volumes.name: 地理与地质
words: a large area of high flat land; a period when something stops rising
The city sits on a dry plateau 2,000 metres above sea level.
这座城市坐落在海拔两千米的干燥高原上。
low land between hills or mountains, often with a river
Farming villages spread along the valley floor.
a deep valley with steep sides, usually cut by a river
Over millions of years, the river carved a canyon through the rock.
数百万年来，河流在岩石中切出了一条峡谷。
a high, steep face of rock, often by the sea
Seabirds nest on the chalk cliffs along the coast.
海鸟在沿岸的白垩悬崖上筑巢。
a long piece of land almost surrounded by water
Italy is a peninsula in southern Europe.
意大利是南欧的一个半岛。
The rough terrain made road building extremely expensive.
崎岖的地形使修路的成本极高。
the visible features of an area of land
Glaciers shaped the landscape of northern Europe.
冰川塑造了北欧的地貌。
the highest point of a mountain; a meeting of leaders
Only a few climbers reached the summit that year.
那一年只有少数登山者登上了山顶。
a surface with one end higher than the other
Tea is grown on the steep slopes of the hills.
茶树种在陡峭的山坡上。
a large area of flat land
The river floods the surrounding plain every spring.
每年春天河水都会淹没周围的平原。
a hill of sand formed by the wind
Shifting dunes can bury roads in a single night.
移动的沙丘一夜之间就能掩埋道路。
a place in a desert with water and plants
Caravans stopped at the oasis to rest and drink.
商队在绿洲停下休息、喝水。
the shape of the land along the sea
Norway has one of the longest coastlines in the world.
挪威拥有世界上最长的海岸线之一。
one of the very large land masses of the earth
Antarctica is the coldest continent on earth.
南极洲是地球上最冷的大陆。
The archipelago consists of more than 7,000 islands.
这个群岛由七千多个岛屿组成。
a long, narrow raised strip of land
The path follows the ridge between two valleys.
小路沿着两条山谷之间的山脊延伸。
a narrow valley with steep rocky walls
A dam was built across the gorge to generate electricity.
峡谷上建了一座水坝用来发电。
a large natural hole in rock or a hillside
Prehistoric paintings were found on the walls of the cave.
洞壁上发现了史前壁画。
Seasons are reversed in the southern hemisphere.
南半球的季节正好相反。
distance north or south of the equator
Plants at high latitudes have a very short growing season.
高纬度地区的植物生长季很短。
distance east or west of a fixed line on the globe
Sailors once had no reliable way to measure longitude at sea.
过去水手在海上没有可靠的方法测量经度。
Breathing becomes harder at high altitude.
在高海拔地区呼吸会变得困难。
the study of rocks and the structure of the earth
The geology of the island explains its fertile soil.
岛上的地质状况解释了它为什么土壤肥沃。
the gradual wearing away of land by water, wind or ice
Coastal erosion threatens hundreds of homes.
海岸侵蚀威胁着数百户房屋。
sand, mud or stones carried and left by water
Layers of sediment slowly harden into rock.
一层层沉积物慢慢硬化成岩石。
a natural substance found in rocks and soil
The region is rich in minerals such as copper and iron.
该地区富含铜、铁等矿物。
the remains of an ancient plant or animal preserved in rock
Fossils show that the area was once covered by sea.
化石表明这里曾经被海水覆盖。
a mountain with an opening through which lava and gas escape
The volcano has been dormant for over two centuries.
这座火山已经沉寂了两百多年。
(of a volcano) to throw out lava, ash and gas
When the volcano erupted, ash fell on towns far away.
火山喷发时，火山灰落到了很远的城镇。
hot liquid rock that comes out of a volcano
熔岩流摧毁了好几个村庄。
a sudden shaking of the ground
Buildings in the region are designed to withstand earthquakes.
该地区的建筑都设计成能抵御地震。
relating to the structure and movement of the earth's crust
The movement of tectonic plates causes earthquakes.
构造板块的移动会引起地震。
the hard outer layer of the earth
The earth's crust is thinnest under the oceans.
the layer of the earth between the crust and the core
Heat from the mantle drives the movement of the plates.
来自地幔的热量推动板块运动。
Seismic activity has increased along the fault.
断层沿线的地震活动增多了。
a very hard grey or pink rock
The cathedral was built from local granite.
这座大教堂是用当地的花岗岩建造的。
a white or grey rock formed from shells and skeletons
Water slowly dissolves limestone and forms caves.
水慢慢溶解石灰岩，形成洞穴。
a solid with a regular shape formed naturally
盐会形成微小的立方体晶体。
a layer of material left by a natural process; money paid in advance
Large deposits of oil were discovered under the seabed.
海底下发现了大量石油矿藏。
the breaking down of rock by wind, rain and changes in temperature
Weathering has rounded the edges of the ancient stones.
风化作用磨圆了古老石块的棱角。
a mass of earth and rock falling down a slope
Heavy rain triggered a landslide that blocked the road.
暴雨引发了山体滑坡，堵住了道路。
(of land) to sink lower; to become less strong
Parts of the city are subsiding because too much groundwater is pumped out.
由于抽取了过多地下水，城市部分地区正在下沉。
using heat from inside the earth
Iceland gets much of its energy from geothermal power.
冰岛的很大一部分能源来自地热发电。
the size of an earthquake; great size or importance
The earthquake had a magnitude of 7.2.
这次地震的震级为 7.2 级。
(of rock or metal) turned to liquid by great heat
The outer core of the earth is made of molten iron.
地球的外核由熔融的铁构成。
Geologists read the earth's history in the rock strata.
地质学家从岩层中解读地球的历史。
a large mass of ice moving slowly down a valley
The glacier has retreated by two kilometres since 1900.
自 1900 年以来，这条冰川已经后退了两公里。
a river that flows into a larger river
Dozens of tributaries feed into the Amazon.
数十条支流汇入亚马孙河。
an artificial lake used to store water
The city's water comes from a reservoir in the hills.
这座城市的水来自山里的一座水库。
water held underground in soil and rock
Farmers depend heavily on groundwater during dry years.
干旱年份农民严重依赖地下水。
flat land where a river divides before entering the sea
The delta is one of the most fertile areas in the country.
这个三角洲是该国最肥沃的地区之一。
the wide part of a river where it meets the sea
Many birds feed on the mudflats of the estuary.
很多鸟在河口的泥滩上觅食。
water falling from a high point
The waterfall drops over 100 metres into the gorge.
瀑布从一百多米高处落入峡谷。
Less than three per cent of the world's water is freshwater.
世界上不到 3% 的水是淡水。
to change from liquid into gas
In hot climates, much of the water evaporates before it reaches the crops.
在炎热的气候里，很多水还没到达庄稼就蒸发了。
flat land next to a river that floods regularly
Building houses on the flood plain is risky.
在泛滥平原上建房子有风险。
high land dividing two river systems; an important turning point
The invention of printing was a watershed in human history.
印刷术的发明是人类历史上的一个转折点。
the bed of a river; a way of communicating
The river cut a new channel after the flood.
洪水过后，河流冲出了一条新河道。
a large amount of fast-moving water
After the storm, the stream became a raging torrent.
暴雨过后，小溪变成了汹涌的激流。
a place where water comes up naturally from the ground
The town grew up around a natural hot spring.
这个小镇是围绕一处天然温泉发展起来的。
(of a river) to follow a winding course
The river meanders slowly across the plain.
河流在平原上缓缓蜿蜒流过。
to make something completely wet; to fill completely
After weeks of rain, the soil was saturated.
下了几个星期的雨，土壤已经饱和了。
a layer of rock that holds groundwater
Over-pumping is draining the aquifer faster than rain can refill it.
过度抽水使含水层枯竭的速度超过了雨水补充的速度。

volumes.name: 天气与气候
words: Advances in meteorology have made forecasts far more accurate.
气象学的进步使天气预报准确得多。
the layer of gases around the earth; the mood of a place
Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere.
二氧化碳把热量困在大气层中。
rain, snow or hail that falls to the ground
Annual precipitation in the region is below 250 mm.
该地区的年降水量不到 250 毫米。
the amount of water in the air
High humidity makes hot weather feel even hotter.
高湿度让炎热的天气感觉更热。
(of air) warm and containing a lot of water
蚊子在湿热的环境中大量繁殖。
a small amount of water in the air, in soil or in a substance
Desert plants store moisture in their leaves.
沙漠植物把水分储存在叶子里。
a statement about what will happen, especially the weather
The forecast warned of heavy snow in the north.
天气预报警告北部将有大雪。
A cool breeze blows in from the sea every afternoon.
每天下午都有凉爽的微风从海上吹来。
a sudden strong rush of wind
Gusts of up to 100 kilometres an hour brought down trees.
时速高达 100 公里的阵风刮倒了树木。
light rain falling in very small drops
The morning began grey, with a light drizzle.
早上天色阴沉，下着毛毛雨。
a sudden heavy fall of rain
A sudden downpour flooded the streets.
一场突如其来的大雨淹没了街道。
small balls of ice falling like rain
Hail damaged crops across the whole valley.
冰雹毁坏了整个山谷的庄稼。
a thin white layer of ice formed on cold nights
An early frost can destroy a whole harvest.
一场早霜就可能毁掉整季收成。
thick cloud close to the ground
Flights were delayed because of dense fog.
a thin cloud of tiny water drops near the ground
Mist rose from the lake in the early morning.
a storm with thunder and lightning
Summer thunderstorms are common in the mountains.
a flash of light in the sky caused by electricity
The fire was started by a lightning strike.
这场火灾是雷击引起的。
The sky remained overcast for most of the week.
这一周大部分时间都是阴天。
how far you can see clearly
Visibility was less than 50 metres in the fog.
雾中能见度不到 50 米。
water that forms when vapour cools
Clouds form through the condensation of water vapour.
云是由水蒸气凝结形成的。
the force of the air pressing on the earth's surface
A fall in air pressure usually brings wet weather.
气压下降通常会带来雨天。
the boundary between two masses of air
A cold weather front is moving in from the west.
一道冷锋正从西边移来。
relating to the hot regions near the equator
Tropical forests are home to more than half of all known species.
已知物种中有一半以上生活在热带森林。
(of a climate) neither very hot nor very cold
Most of Europe has a temperate climate.
欧洲大部分地区属于温带气候。
relating to the areas around the North or South Pole
Polar bears depend on sea ice to hunt.
Arid regions cover about a third of the earth's land.
干旱地区约占地球陆地的三分之一。
the season of heavy rain in South and Southeast Asia
Farmers plant rice at the start of the monsoon.
农民在雨季开始时种水稻。
happening or needed during a particular season
Seasonal workers are hired for the harvest.
收获季节会雇用季节工。
the amount of rain that falls
Average rainfall has dropped by 15 per cent since 1970.
自 1970 年以来，平均降雨量下降了 15%。
warming caused by gases trapping heat in the atmosphere
Without the greenhouse effect, the earth would be too cold for life.
没有温室效应，地球就会冷得不适合生命生存。
a gas, such as carbon dioxide, that traps heat in the atmosphere
Agriculture produces a large share of greenhouse gases.
农业产生了很大一部分温室气体。
the gas produced when fuels such as coal and oil are burnt
Trees absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
树木从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
a gas produced by rotting plants and by cattle
Methane traps far more heat than carbon dioxide.
甲烷吸收的热量远多于二氧化碳。
a layer of gas high above the earth that blocks harmful sunlight
The ban on certain chemicals has helped the ozone layer to recover.
对某些化学品的禁令帮助臭氧层逐渐恢复。
a long period when ice covered much of the earth
During the last ice age, sea levels were much lower.
上一个冰河时期，海平面要低得多。
relating to ice and glaciers; extremely slow
The lake was formed by glacial action.
这个湖是冰川作用形成的。
to change from solid to liquid through heat
Rising temperatures are melting the polar ice caps.
气温上升正在融化极地冰盖。
the average height of the sea's surface
Rising sea levels threaten low-lying islands.
海平面上升威胁着地势低的岛屿。
a period of unusually hot weather
The heatwave led to a sharp rise in hospital admissions.
热浪导致住院人数急剧上升。
an imaginary line around the middle of the earth
Countries near the equator have little seasonal change.
赤道附近的国家季节变化很小。
the climate of a small area that differs from the area around it
City centres create a warmer microclimate.
城市中心形成了较暖的小气候。
Climatologists study ice cores to learn about past climates.
气候学家通过研究冰芯来了解过去的气候。
higher, lower or greater than ever before
Last summer saw record-breaking temperatures across Europe.
去年夏天欧洲各地出现了破纪录的高温。
the wind that blows most often in an area
The prevailing wind carries pollution towards the east.
盛行风把污染物带向东边。
a violent storm with very strong winds, especially in the Atlantic
The hurricane caused billions of dollars of damage.
这场飓风造成了数十亿美元的损失。
a violent tropical storm in the western Pacific
Typhoons regularly hit the coast in late summer.
夏末台风经常袭击沿海地区。
a column of air spinning very fast
A tornado can destroy a house in seconds.
龙卷风几秒钟就能摧毁一栋房子。
a violent tropical storm in the Indian Ocean
The cyclone forced thousands of families to leave their homes.
气旋迫使数千户家庭离开家园。
a severe snowstorm with strong winds
Schools were closed for three days because of the blizzard.
由于暴风雪，学校停课三天。
a large mass of snow falling down a mountain
Skiers are warned to stay on marked runs because of the avalanche risk.
由于有雪崩风险，滑雪者被提醒待在标记的雪道上。
a huge wave caused by an earthquake under the sea
The tsunami reached the coast within twenty minutes.
海啸在二十分钟内就抵达了海岸。
a sudden flood caused by heavy rain
Flash floods can happen with almost no warning.
暴洪几乎可以在毫无预警的情况下发生。
a large fire that spreads quickly in the countryside
Hot, dry winds made the wildfire impossible to control.
干热的风让山火无法控制。
a rise in sea level caused by a storm
The storm surge flooded much of the coastal city.
风暴潮淹没了这座沿海城市的大部分地区。
The earthquake had a devastating effect on the region.
地震给该地区造成了毁灭性的影响。
causing sudden great damage or suffering
A rise of four degrees would have catastrophic consequences.
升温四度将带来灾难性的后果。
to move people from a dangerous place to a safe one
Residents were evacuated before the storm arrived.
风暴到来之前居民已被疏散。
a sign or system that gives notice of danger in advance
An early warning system saved thousands of lives.
预警系统挽救了成千上万的生命。
to say what will happen in the future
Scientists still cannot predict exactly when earthquakes will occur.
科学家仍然无法准确预测地震何时发生。
Severe weather is becoming more frequent.
the period after a disaster and its effects
In the aftermath of the flood, disease spread quickly.
洪水过后，疾病迅速蔓延。
Low-lying coastal areas are particularly vulnerable to flooding.
低洼的沿海地区特别容易遭受洪水。
able to recover quickly from difficulty
Communities need more resilient housing and infrastructure.
社区需要更能抵御灾害的住房和基础设施。

volumes.name: 植物
words: She studied botany before becoming a gardener.
她在当园艺师之前学过植物学。
Botanists have identified over 300 new species in the region.
植物学家在该地区发现了三百多个新物种。
the leaves of a plant or tree
The dense foliage provides shelter for birds.
茂密的枝叶为鸟类提供了栖身之所。
the main stem of a tree
The age of a tree can be measured by the rings in its trunk.
树的年龄可以通过树干上的年轮来测定。
the hard outer layer of a tree
The medicine was originally made from willow bark.
这种药最初是用柳树皮做的。
one of the coloured parts of a flower
Bees are attracted by the colour of the petals.
蜜蜂被花瓣的颜色吸引。
fine powder produced by flowers to fertilise other flowers
Many people suffer from allergies to grass pollen.
a sweet liquid produced by flowers
a thin thread of natural or artificial material; the part of food that helps digestion
Cotton fibre is spun into thread.
a group of cells that form part of a plant or animal
受损的叶片组织会变成褐色。
the green substance in plants that absorbs light
Chlorophyll allows plants to use the energy of sunlight.
叶绿素使植物能够利用阳光的能量。
the process by which plants make food from light, water and carbon dioxide
Photosynthesis releases oxygen into the air.
光合作用向空气中释放氧气。
the top layer of branches in a forest
Most rainforest animals live high in the canopy.
大多数雨林动物生活在高高的林冠层。
a small bush with several woody stems
The hillside is covered with low shrubs and grasses.
山坡上长满了低矮的灌木和草。
a climbing plant, especially one that produces grapes
The vines are harvested in late September.
a small green plant that grows in damp places
Moss covered the north side of the old stones.
苔藓覆盖了古石的北面。
a plant with feathery leaves and no flowers
Ferns were among the first plants to grow on land.
蕨类是最早在陆地上生长的植物之一。
a living thing such as a mushroom or mould
The fungus attacks the roots of young trees.
这种真菌侵害幼树的根部。
simple plants that grow in water
Warm water encourages the growth of algae.
温暖的水促进藻类生长。
(of trees) losing their leaves every year
Oak and maple are deciduous trees.
(of plants) living for several years; lasting a long time
Perennial crops reduce soil erosion because they are not replanted every year.
多年生作物不需要每年重新种植，因此能减少水土流失。
(of a seed) to start to grow
Some seeds only germinate after a forest fire.
有些种子只有在森林大火后才会发芽。
to start to grow leaves or shoots
New shoots sprout from the stump within weeks.
几周之内，树桩上就冒出了新芽。
flowers on a fruit tree; to produce flowers
The cherry trees blossom in early April.
The desert blooms for a few weeks after the rains.
雨后沙漠会开花几个星期。
to carry pollen to a flower so it can produce seeds
Bees pollinate about a third of the crops we eat.
我们吃的作物中约三分之一靠蜜蜂授粉。
an insect or animal that carries pollen between flowers
The decline of pollinators threatens food production.
传粉者数量下降威胁着粮食生产。
to make a plant or egg able to develop; to add fertiliser to soil
Farmers fertilise the fields before planting.
农民在播种前给田地施肥。
the spreading of seeds away from the parent plant
Birds play a key role in seed dispersal.
鸟类在种子传播中起着关键作用。
(of a plant) to become dry and die
Without rain, the crops withered in the fields.
没有雨水，庄稼在田里枯萎了。
to be slowly destroyed by natural processes
Fallen leaves decay and enrich the soil.
落叶腐烂后使土壤更肥沃。
to break down into simpler substances
Plastic bags can take hundreds of years to decompose.
塑料袋需要几百年才能分解。
a substance that living things need to grow
Heavy rain washes nutrients out of the soil.
大雨会把养分从土壤中冲走。
to take in a liquid, gas or other substance
Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil.
根从土壤中吸收水分和矿物质。
to grow well; to be successful
Wild flowers flourish in the cool, damp climate.
野花在凉爽潮湿的气候中长得很茂盛。
These plants thrive in poor, sandy soil.
这些植物在贫瘠的沙质土壤中长得很好。
alive but not active or growing
Seeds can remain dormant in the soil for decades.
种子可以在土壤里休眠几十年。
to produce young or new plants
有些植物不靠种子繁殖。
a plant or animal produced from two different kinds
The new hybrid rice produces higher yields.
新的杂交水稻产量更高。
a young plant grown from a seed
The seedlings are moved outdoors after six weeks.
幼苗六周后被移到室外。
all the roots of a plant
Trees with deep root systems survive dry summers better.
根系深的树更能熬过干燥的夏天。
a tiny cell from which ferns and fungi grow
Ferns spread by releasing millions of spores.
蕨类通过释放数百万个孢子来繁殖。
to change to suit new conditions
Desert plants have adapted to survive with very little water.
沙漠植物已经适应了在极少水分下生存。
a plant used in cooking or medicine
Mint and basil are easy herbs to grow at home.
薄荷和罗勒是在家容易种的香草。
Many rainforest plants have medicinal properties.
很多雨林植物有药用价值。
to grow plants; to develop a skill or relationship
Rice has been cultivated in China for thousands of years.
中国种植水稻已有几千年历史。
Demand for timber is a major cause of deforestation.
对木材的需求是森林砍伐的主要原因之一。
a thick tropical forest with heavy rainfall
The Amazon rainforest produces much of its own rain.
亚马孙雨林的很多降雨是它自己产生的。
plants in general, especially those in a particular area
Grazing animals have stripped the hills of vegetation.
放牧的牲畜把山上的植被啃光了。
all the plants of a particular area or period
The island's flora includes many unique species.
这个岛的植物群包括许多独有的物种。
growing or living naturally in a place
Gardeners are encouraged to plant native species.
园艺师被鼓励种植本地物种。
a plant or animal that spreads harmfully in a new place
Invasive species can wipe out native plants.
入侵物种可能让本地植物灭绝。
a wild plant growing where it is not wanted
Farmers use chemicals to control weeds.
农民用化学药剂控制杂草。
Some common garden plants are toxic to pets.
一些常见的园艺植物对宠物有毒。
Only a few of the mushrooms in the forest are edible.
森林里的蘑菇只有少数可以食用。
a garden where plants are grown for study and display
The botanical garden keeps seeds of rare plants.

地球磁场保护我们免受太阳辐射。
energy sent out as waves or particles
Astronauts are exposed to higher levels of radiation.
宇航员受到的辐射水平更高。
a space with no air or matter in it
Sound cannot travel through a vacuum.
声音无法在真空中传播。
a very small piece of matter
Tiny particles of dust can travel thousands of kilometres.
微小的尘埃颗粒可以飘行数千公里。
the smallest unit of a chemical element
Everything around us is made of atoms.
我们周围的一切都是由原子构成的。
the smallest unit of a substance, made of atoms
A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。
joining atoms together to release energy
The sun produces energy through nuclear fusion.
太阳通过核聚变产生能量。
(of light) just beyond red, invisible to the eye
Infrared cameras can detect animals in the dark.
红外摄像机能在黑暗中探测到动物。
(of light) just beyond violet, invisible to the eye
Ultraviolet rays from the sun can damage the skin.
太阳的紫外线会损伤皮肤。
the range of colours in light; a full range of something
Stars give off light across the whole spectrum.
恒星发出的光覆盖整个光谱。
an imaginary line around which something turns; a line on a graph
The earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours.
地球每 24 小时绕地轴自转一圈。
to turn around a central point
The blades of a wind turbine rotate more slowly than they appear to.
风力涡轮机的叶片转得比看上去慢。
to move in a circle around something
The planets revolve around the sun.
the distance between two waves of light or sound
Blue light has a shorter wavelength than red light.

volumes.name: 考古与古代文明
words: the study of the past through objects and buildings left by people
Archaeology has changed our understanding of early farming.
考古学改变了我们对早期农业的认识。
Archaeologists found the remains of a Roman villa under the car park.
考古学家在停车场下发现了一座古罗马别墅的遗迹。
to dig carefully to find ancient objects
The team excavated the site over three summers.
考古队用了三个夏天发掘这处遗址。
an object made by people, especially one of historical interest
Over 2,000 artefacts were recovered from the tomb.
墓中出土了两千多件文物。
an object from the past that has survived
The coins are relics of a once powerful trading city.
这些硬币是一座曾经强盛的贸易城市的遗物。
the parts left after something has been destroyed or has died
The remains of an ancient wall were found beneath the church.
教堂下面发现了一道古城墙的遗迹。
the remaining parts of buildings that have been destroyed
Tourists walk among the ruins of the ancient city.
游客们在古城的废墟中漫步。
to dig something out of the ground; to discover
Farmers unearthed a hoard of gold coins while ploughing.
农民在耕地时挖出了一批金币。
a method of finding the age of very old objects
Carbon dating showed that the bones were 9,000 years old.
碳年代测定显示这些骨头有九千年历史。
to have existed since a particular time
The earliest parts of the temple date back to 2000 BC.
这座神庙最早的部分可以追溯到公元前 2000 年。
from the time before written records
Prehistoric people painted animals on cave walls.
史前人类在洞壁上画动物。
the period when people made tools from stone
Stone Age hunters followed herds of reindeer.
石器时代的猎人追随驯鹿群迁移。
the period when people made tools from bronze
Trade networks expanded rapidly during the Bronze Age.
青铜时代贸易网络迅速扩张。
a person who lives by hunting and collecting wild food
For most of human history, people lived as hunter-gatherers.
在人类历史的大部分时间里，人们以狩猎采集为生。
moving from place to place rather than living in one place
Nomadic herders move their animals with the seasons.
游牧民随季节迁移牲畜。
a place where people have come to live
The first permanent settlements appeared after farming began.
农业出现后才有了最早的永久定居点。
the act of putting a dead body in the ground
Objects placed in burials show what people valued.
随葬物品显示了人们看重什么。
a large grave, often with a stone structure
The pharaoh's tomb was hidden for over 3,000 years.
这位法老的陵墓隐藏了三千多年。
the frame of bones in a body
The skeleton showed signs of a hard working life.
这副骨骼显示出生前劳作艰辛的迹象。
a sign that something existed; to find the origin of something
Traces of wheat were found in the clay pots.
在陶罐里发现了小麦的痕迹。
the order in which events happened
Tree rings help researchers build an accurate chronology.
树木年轮帮助研究人员建立准确的年表。
belonging to an early stage of development
Even primitive tools required great skill to make.
即使是原始的工具，制作起来也需要高超的技艺。
a society with its own culture, government and way of life
The Indus Valley civilisation had advanced drainage systems.
印度河流域文明拥有先进的排水系统。
from a very long time ago
Ancient Greek ideas still shape Western politics.
古希腊的思想至今仍影响着西方政治。
a group of countries ruled by one ruler or government
At its height, the Roman Empire stretched from Britain to Egypt.
罗马帝国鼎盛时期从英国一直延伸到埃及。
a series of rulers from the same family
The Ming dynasty is famous for its blue and white porcelain.
The emperor ordered the construction of a new capital.
The pyramids were built as tombs for the pharaohs.
金字塔是作为法老的陵墓建造的。
a large stone building with a square base and four sloping sides
Historians still debate how the pyramids were built.
历史学家仍在争论金字塔是如何建成的。
The temple was dedicated to the god of the sun.
a structure built to remember a person or event; an old building of historical importance
Stonehenge is one of the most famous prehistoric monuments in Europe.
巨石阵是欧洲最著名的史前遗迹之一。
words carved on stone, metal or wood
The inscription on the stone records a royal victory.
石碑上的铭文记录了一次王室的胜利。
a picture used as a symbol in ancient Egyptian writing
Scholars could not read hieroglyphs until the 1820s.
直到 19 世纪 20 年代学者们才能读懂象形文字。
The Indus script has never been deciphered.
印度河文字至今没有被破译。
a group of families with the same language and customs
Each tribe had its own territory and leaders.
每个部落都有自己的领地和首领。
a ceremony performed in a fixed way
Burial rituals varied greatly between cultures.
不同文化的丧葬仪式差别很大。
to show respect and love for a god
The ancient Egyptians worshipped many gods.
The river was sacred to the people who lived along it.
对沿岸居民来说，这条河是神圣的。
an ancient story about gods and heroes; a false belief
It is a myth that the Great Wall can be seen from space with the naked eye.
用肉眼从太空中能看到长城的说法是个谣传。
a traditional story that may not be true
According to legend, the city was founded by twin brothers.
据传说，这座城市是由一对双胞胎兄弟建立的。
to take control of a country by force
The empire conquered most of its neighbours within a century.
这个帝国在一个世纪内征服了大部分邻国。
a bridge or channel built to carry water
Roman aqueducts carried water to cities from distant hills.
古罗马的引水渠把远处山上的水引到城市。
a city that is an independent state
Athens and Sparta were rival city-states.
雅典和斯巴达是相互竞争的城邦。
a route regularly used by traders
The Silk Road was a network of trade routes linking China and Europe.
丝绸之路是连接中国和欧洲的贸易路线网络。
pots and other objects made from clay
Fragments of pottery reveal what people cooked and stored.
陶器碎片揭示了人们烹煮和储存什么。
objects made of clay and baked; the art of making them
Chinese ceramics were exported as far as East Africa.
a work of art made by shaping stone, wood or metal
The museum's sculpture collection includes Roman marble busts.
博物馆的雕塑藏品包括古罗马的大理石半身像。
a figure of a person or animal made of stone or metal
A bronze statue of the founder stands in the square.
广场上矗立着一尊创始人的铜像。
a large painting on a wall
Murals in the tomb show scenes of daily life.
墓中的壁画描绘了日常生活场景。
a book or document written by hand
The library holds medieval manuscripts written on animal skin.
图书馆收藏着写在兽皮上的中世纪手抄本。
a long roll of paper with writing on it
The ancient scrolls were found in a cave near the Dead Sea.
这些古卷是在死海附近的一个洞穴里发现的。
Gold ornaments were buried with the king.
金饰品与国王一同下葬。
rings, necklaces and other decorative items worn on the body
Shell jewellery is among the oldest known art.
贝壳首饰是已知最古老的艺术品之一。
Silk was one of the most valuable textiles in the ancient world.
丝绸是古代世界最珍贵的纺织品之一。
a small flat piece of metal used as money
Roman coins have been found as far away as India.
在远至印度的地方都发现过罗马硬币。
the history, traditions and buildings of a country
The old town is an important part of the nation's heritage.
老城是国家遗产的重要组成部分。
Remarkably, the tomb was found intact.
令人惊讶的是，这座墓被发现时完好无损。
a small piece broken off something
Only fragments of the original painting survive.
Experts confirmed that the vase was authentic.
专家确认这个花瓶是真品。
Visitors see a replica, while the original is kept safe.
游客看到的是复制品，原件被妥善保存。
a person who manages a museum's collection
The curator explained how the objects were restored.
策展人讲解了这些文物是如何修复的。
to show objects in public; an object on display
The gallery exhibits works from over 40 countries.
这家美术馆展出来自四十多个国家的作品。
a place listed by UNESCO for its cultural or natural value
The old city was named a World Heritage Site in 1980.
这座古城于 1980 年被列为世界遗产。

volumes.name: 历史与社会变迁
words: The invention of the internet marked the start of a new era.
互联网的发明标志着一个新时代的开始。
a long period of time with particular features
Some scientists say we have entered a new geological epoch.
一些科学家说我们已经进入了一个新的地质时期。
from the period between about 500 and 1500 AD
The town still has its medieval walls.
这个小镇至今仍保留着中世纪的城墙。
the revival of art and learning in Europe in the 14th to 16th centuries
Florence was the centre of the Renaissance.
佛罗伦萨是文艺复兴的中心。
relating to a colony or to colonialism
Many borders in Africa date from the colonial period.
非洲的许多边界可以追溯到殖民时期。
a sudden, complete change, especially in government
法国大革命始于 1789 年。
an act of violent protest against authority
The peasants' revolt was quickly crushed.
violent action against those in power
The rebellion spread across the southern provinces.
The invasion was launched from across the sea.
freedom from control by another country
这个国家于 1947 年获得独立。
The treaty ended more than thirty years of war.
这项条约结束了三十多年的战争。
the period during which a king or queen rules
Many great buildings were completed during her reign.
许多宏伟的建筑在她统治期间完工。
the highest social class, usually with titles
Land was owned mainly by the aristocracy.
a poor farmer in the past
Most peasants worked land that belonged to others.
大多数农民耕种别人的土地。
relating to the medieval system in which people worked land for a lord
Under the feudal system, peasants owed labour to their lord.
在封建制度下，农民要为领主服劳役。
the system of owning people as property
Slavery was abolished in most of the British Empire in 1833.
大英帝国的大部分地区于 1833 年废除了奴隶制。
to officially end a law or system
Many countries have abolished the death penalty.
许多国家已经废除了死刑。
one of the first people to do something
She was a pioneer of women's education.
a time when an important change happens
The battle was a turning point in the war.
这场战役是战争的转折点。
Historians disagree about what caused the collapse of the Maya cities.
历史学家对玛雅城市衰落的原因看法不一。
The city enjoyed a golden age of art and trade in the 15th century.
这座城市在 15 世纪迎来了艺术和贸易的黄金时代。
a written record of events in the order they happened
Monks kept chronicles of important events.
修道士们把重要事件记入编年史。
a system of government in which people choose their leaders by voting
Athens is often described as the birthplace of democracy.
雅典常被称为民主的发源地。
a system in which a king or queen is head of state
英国是君主立宪制国家。
the group of elected people who make the laws
The bill was debated in parliament for months.
这项法案在议会里辩论了好几个月。
a country with an elected leader rather than a king
意大利于 1946 年成为共和国。
the legal right to belong to a country
Immigrants can apply for citizenship after several years of residence.
移民在居住若干年后可以申请公民身份。
the right to vote in elections
Women's suffrage was achieved in New Zealand in 1893.
新西兰的女性在 1893 年获得了选举权。
a change made to improve a system
Education reform was the government's top priority.
教育改革是政府的头等大事。
an official count of a country's population
The census is carried out every ten years.
人口普查每十年进行一次。
the rights of every person to equal treatment
The civil rights movement changed American society.
民权运动改变了美国社会。
information, often false, used to influence people
Both sides used posters as propaganda during the war.
战争期间双方都用海报做宣传。
The two parties are divided by ideology.
两党在意识形态上存在分歧。
a government, especially one not chosen fairly; a system of rules
The old regime fell after weeks of protest.
旧政权在数周的抗议后垮台。
a situation in which people fight against those in power
The uprising forced the king to accept a new constitution.
起义迫使国王接受了新宪法。
a group of people with similar status and wealth
Education was once limited by social class.
过去受教育的机会受社会阶层限制。
people with average income and education
The middle class grew rapidly in the 19th century.
中产阶级在 19 世纪迅速壮大。
people who do manual or industrial work
Working-class families often lived in crowded housing.
工人阶级家庭常常住在拥挤的房子里。
the state of having the same rights and opportunities
The law guarantees equality between men and women.
organisations working to improve workers' rights
The labour movement won shorter working hours.
劳工运动争取到了更短的工作时间。
strong support for one's own nation
Nationalism grew across Europe in the 19th century.
19 世纪民族主义在欧洲各地兴起。
a special right or advantage held by some people
Education was once a privilege of the rich.
教育曾经是富人的特权。
keeping groups apart, especially by race
Racial segregation in American schools was ruled unconstitutional in 1954.
1954 年美国学校的种族隔离被裁定违宪。
the development of industry on a large scale
Industrialisation drew millions of people into cities.
工业化把数百万人吸引到城市。
the period from about 1760 when machines changed how goods were made
The Industrial Revolution began in the textile industry.
Improved steam engines powered factories and trains.
改进后的蒸汽机为工厂和火车提供动力。
a factory where cloth is made
Children as young as six worked in textile mills.
年仅六岁的孩子就在纺织厂做工。
making large numbers of identical goods by machine
Mass production made cars affordable for ordinary families.
大规模生产让普通家庭也买得起汽车。
a line of workers and machines that put a product together step by step
The assembly line cut the time to build a car from about twelve hours to under two.
流水线把造一辆车的时间从大约十二小时缩短到不到两小时。
to make goods in large numbers using machines
The town manufactures most of the country's steel.
这个城镇生产了全国大部分的钢铁。
the movement of large numbers of people from the countryside to cities
The rural exodus left many villages almost empty.
农村人口外流使许多村庄几乎空无一人。
all the railway lines in a country
The railway network allowed fresh food to reach city markets.
铁路网让新鲜食品能运到城市市场。
an old system for sending messages along wires
The telegraph allowed news to cross the ocean in minutes.
电报让新闻几分钟内就能跨越大洋。
a machine for printing books and newspapers
The printing press made books cheaper and more widely available.
印刷机使书籍更便宜、更普及。
to bring something up to date
The government spent heavily to modernise the railways.
政府投入巨资使铁路现代化。
the level of wealth and comfort people have
Living standards rose steadily after the war.
战后生活水平稳步提高。
standard of living, quality of life
all the people who work in a country or company
Women made up a third of the factory workforce.
女性占工厂劳动力的三分之一。
The Factory Act of 1833 limited the hours that children could work in textile mills.
1833 年的《工厂法》限制了儿童在纺织厂的工作时长。
an organisation that protects workers' rights
The trade union negotiated higher wages.
工会争取到了更高的工资。
money paid to a worker, usually weekly
Wages in the factories were very low.
Mechanised farming needs far fewer workers.
机械化农业所需的劳动力少得多。
a person who buys and sells goods in large amounts
Wealthy merchants paid for many of the city's churches.
富商出资修建了城里的许多教堂。
the activity of buying and selling
The port became a centre of commerce.
这个港口成了商业中心。

volumes.name: 心理与行为
words: a person who studies the human mind and behaviour
The psychologist interviewed each child twice.
这位心理学家对每个孩子做了两次访谈。
connected with thinking, learning and remembering
Puzzles may help to slow cognitive decline in older people.
益智游戏可能有助于减缓老年人的认知衰退。
the ability to remember things; something you remember
Sleep plays an important role in forming long-term memories.
睡眠对形成长期记忆起着重要作用。
to bring a fact or event back into your mind
Participants were asked to recall a list of twenty words.
参与者被要求回忆一份二十个单词的清单。
the state of being awake and aware of your surroundings
Scientists still cannot fully explain consciousness.
科学家至今仍无法完全解释意识。
existing in the mind without your being aware of it
Advertisers try to influence our subconscious choices.
广告商试图影响我们潜意识中的选择。
the length of time a person can concentrate on something
Some teachers believe that screens shorten children's attention spans.
一些老师认为屏幕会缩短孩子的注意力持续时间。
the process of thinking about something in a logical way
The test measures verbal and spatial reasoning.
这项测试衡量语言推理和空间推理能力。
the ability to know something without thinking it through
Experienced nurses often rely on intuition as well as data.
有经验的护士常常既依靠数据，也依靠直觉。
connected with the senses of sight, hearing, smell, taste or touch
Babies learn through sensory experiences such as touch and sound.
婴儿通过触摸和声音等感官体验来学习。
The rats responded to a light stimulus within half a second.
老鼠在半秒内对光刺激做出了反应。
a movement your body makes automatically, without thinking
Blinking is a reflex that protects the eyes.
眨眼是一种保护眼睛的反射动作。
something that seems real or true but is not
The two lines look different in length, but it is only an optical illusion.
这两条线看起来长短不同，但那只是视错觉。
a person's usual way of thinking about things
Students with a growth mindset see mistakes as a chance to learn.
具有成长型思维的学生把错误看作学习的机会。
the qualities that make up a person's character
Personality tests are widely used in recruitment.
性格测试被广泛用于招聘。
a quiet person who prefers to spend time alone or with a few people
Introverts often prefer to think before they speak.
内向的人往往更喜欢先想后说。
a lively person who enjoys being with other people
An extrovert may find working from home lonely.
外向的人可能会觉得在家工作很孤单。
a person's natural character, especially how they react emotionally
Even newborn babies seem to differ in temperament.
即使是新生儿，性情似乎也各不相同。
something you do regularly, often without thinking
It takes about two months, on average, to form a new habit.
平均来说，养成一个新习惯大约需要两个月。
the process of deciding about something important
Tiredness has a strong effect on decision-making.
疲劳对决策有很大影响。
the ability to make sensible decisions; an opinion
压力会影响我们的判断力。
the process of finding answers to difficult questions
乌鸦表现出惊人的解决问题的能力。
a strong feeling such as love, fear or anger
音乐能引发强烈的情感。
a feeling of worry about what might happen
考试焦虑影响着许多学生。
the feeling of being annoyed because you cannot do what you want
Toddlers often cry out of frustration.
学步的幼儿常常因为受挫而哭闹。
the ability to understand how another person feels
Reading novels may help children develop empathy.
读小说可能有助于孩子培养同理心。
the feeling of being happy with your own character and abilities
Constant criticism can damage a child's self-esteem.
不断的批评会伤害孩子的自尊心。
the belief that you can do things well
Speaking in public helped her gain confidence.
公开演讲帮助她建立了自信。
to deal successfully with something difficult
Teenagers need support to cope with exam pressure.
青少年需要支持来应对考试压力。
the way you feel at a particular time
Regular exercise can improve your mood.
经常锻炼可以改善心情。
a very strong fear of something, often without good reason
A fear of spiders is one of the most common phobias.
怕蜘蛛是最常见的恐惧症之一。
a very upsetting experience that has a lasting effect
Survivors of the earthquake received help to deal with trauma.
地震幸存者接受了帮助，以应对心理创伤。
the time when a person is a child
Many adult habits are formed in early childhood.
许多成年人的习惯是在幼年时期形成的。
the time when a person is a baby; the early stage of something
the time when a young person develops into an adult
Sleep patterns change a great deal during adolescence.
青春期的睡眠模式会发生很大变化。
a young child who has just learned to walk
Toddlers learn several new words every day.
学步的幼儿每天都会学会几个新词。
the way a child is cared for and taught by its parents
Her strict upbringing made her very independent.
严格的家教让她非常独立。
to care for and encourage the growth of someone or something
Good teachers nurture curiosity in their pupils.
好老师会培养学生的好奇心。
First-born children often take care of their younger siblings.
长子长女常常要照顾弟弟妹妹。
a person whom others admire and copy
Sports stars are role models for millions of young people.
体育明星是数百万年轻人的榜样。
the influence of people of your own age to behave like them
Peer pressure can lead teenagers to start smoking.
同伴压力可能导致青少年开始吸烟。
to spend time with other people for pleasure; to teach someone how to behave in society
Puppies need to socialise with other dogs from an early age.
小狗从小就需要和别的狗相处。
an important stage in someone's development or progress
Walking and talking are major milestones in a child's first years.
走路和说话是孩子头几年的重要里程碑。
the unhappy feeling of being alone
Loneliness is a growing problem among older people.
孤独在老年人中是一个日益严重的问题。
a scientific test to find out what happens in certain conditions
In one famous experiment, children watched adults hit a doll.
在一项著名的实验中，孩子们观看大人击打一个玩偶。
a group in an experiment that does not receive the treatment being tested
The control group was given a sugar pill instead of the drug.
对照组服用的是糖丸而不是药物。
a harmless substance given instead of a real drug
Some patients felt better after taking a placebo.
有些病人服用安慰剂后感觉好转了。
the act of watching something carefully
The study was based on two years of observation in schools.
这项研究基于在学校两年的观察。
a set of written questions used to collect information
Over 500 people completed the online questionnaire.
五百多人填写了这份在线问卷。
a small group or amount chosen to represent a larger one
The sample was too small to draw firm conclusions.
样本太小，无法得出确切的结论。
a connection between two things that change together
There is a strong correlation between sleep and exam results.
睡眠和考试成绩之间有很强的相关性。
the process of one thing directly causing another
A correlation alone does not prove causation.
仅有相关性并不能证明因果关系。
the information discovered as a result of research
The findings were published in a leading journal.
研究结果发表在一份权威期刊上。
to repeat a study or experiment to see if the results are the same
Other scientists failed to replicate the results.
其他科学家没能重复出这一结果。
research that follows the same people over many years
A longitudinal study followed 1,000 children from birth to the age of 32.
一项纵向研究追踪了一千名儿童，从出生一直到 32 岁。
a detailed study of one person, group or event
The book includes a case study of a boy who grew up without language.
这本书收录了一个男孩在没有语言的环境中长大的个案研究。
connected with the way people or animals behave
Behavioural problems often improve with regular routines.
有规律的作息常常能改善行为问题。
training that makes a person or animal react to a stimulus in a certain way
Pavlov's dogs learned through conditioning to expect food when they heard a certain sound.
巴甫洛夫的狗通过条件反射训练，学会了听到某种声音就期待食物。
something given for good behaviour or hard work
Children worked harder when a small reward was offered.
有小奖励时，孩子们更努力了。
a way of making someone suffer because they have done something wrong
Studies suggest that praise works better than punishment.
研究表明，表扬比惩罚更有效。
the lack of something that you need
Even one night of sleep deprivation can affect memory.
即使只有一晚睡眠不足，也会影响记忆力。
the scientific study of the brain and nerves
Advances in neuroscience have changed how we think about learning.
神经科学的进步改变了我们对学习的认识。
a cell that carries messages between the brain and other parts of the body
The human brain contains around 86 billion neurons.
人脑大约有 860 亿个神经元。

volumes.name: 语言与交流
words: She studied linguistics at university before becoming a teacher.
她在成为老师之前在大学学习语言学。
语言学家；精通多种语言的人
a person who studies languages or speaks several languages well
Linguists estimate that about 7,000 languages are spoken today.
语言学家估计，如今世界上使用的语言大约有七千种。
all the words that a person knows or that a language has
Reading widely is the best way to expand your vocabulary.
广泛阅读是扩大词汇量的最好方法。
the rules for forming words and sentences in a language
Children learn the grammar of their first language without formal lessons.
孩子们不用上正式的课就能学会母语的语法。
the way words are arranged to form sentences
Japanese syntax places the verb at the end of the sentence.
日语句法把动词放在句末。
a form of a language spoken in one area
Many local dialects are disappearing as people move to cities.
随着人们迁往城市，许多地方方言正在消失。
a way of pronouncing words that shows where someone comes from
The IELTS listening test uses speakers with a range of accents.
雅思听力考试使用多种口音的说话人。
the way in which a word is said
English spelling is a poor guide to pronunciation.
英语的拼写很难反映发音。
the first language that a person learns
Children learn best when they are first taught in their mother tongue.
孩子先用母语接受教学时学得最好。
able to speak two languages equally well
Bilingual children may be better at switching between tasks.
双语儿童可能更擅长在不同任务之间切换。
using or able to speak several languages
Switzerland is a multilingual country with four national languages.
瑞士是一个有四种国家语言的多语国家。
the set of letters used to write a language
The Greek alphabet was adapted from an earlier Phoenician script.
希腊字母是从更早的腓尼基文字改编而来的。
a letter or sign used in writing; a person in a story
Educated readers of Chinese know several thousand characters.
受过教育的中文读者认识几千个汉字。
connected with the sounds of speech
The dictionary shows the phonetic spelling of each word.
这本词典标出了每个词的音标。
the origin and history of a word
The etymology of 'salary' may go back to the Latin word for salt.
“salary”的词源可能要追溯到拉丁语中表示“盐”的词。
a word taken from another language
'Ketchup' is a loanword that probably came from a Chinese dialect.
“ketchup”是一个外来词，很可能来自中国的某种方言。
a group of words whose meaning differs from the meanings of the separate words
Idioms such as 'break the ice' are hard for learners to guess.
像“break the ice”这样的习语，学习者很难猜出意思。
a short well-known saying that gives advice
An old proverb says that practice makes perfect.
有句老谚语说，熟能生巧。
a group of languages that developed from a common ancestor
English and Hindi belong to the same language family.
英语和印地语属于同一语系。
a language used between people whose first languages are different
English has become the lingua franca of international science.
英语已成为国际科学界的通用语。
to discover the meaning of something that is difficult to read
The Rosetta Stone helped scholars decipher Egyptian hieroglyphs.
罗塞塔石碑帮助学者破译了埃及象形文字。
to change words from one language into another
The novel has been translated into more than forty languages.
这部小说已被译成四十多种语言。
the process by which people learn a language
Research on language acquisition shows that children learn through play.
语言习得研究表明，孩子是在玩耍中学习的。
able to speak a language easily and well
He became fluent in Italian after two years in Rome.
在罗马待了两年后，他的意大利语变得很流利。
a high level of skill or ability
Universities usually ask for proof of English proficiency.
大学通常要求提供英语水平证明。
learning a language by living or studying where only that language is used
A month of immersion can be worth a year of classes.
沉浸式学习一个月可能抵得上一年的课。
a person who learned a language as a child
Even native speakers make grammar mistakes in casual speech.
即使是母语者，在随意交谈中也会犯语法错误。
a time early in life when certain skills are learned most easily
Some researchers argue that there is a critical period for learning accents.
一些研究者认为，学习口音存在一个关键期。
to copy someone's behaviour or way of speaking
Babies imitate the sounds they hear around them.
婴儿会模仿周围听到的声音。
to learn something so that you can remember it exactly
Memorising word lists is less useful than reading.
背单词表不如阅读有用。
learn by heart, commit to memory
Reading comprehension improves when learners know more vocabulary.
学习者词汇量越大，阅读理解能力越强。
to express ideas clearly; able to express ideas clearly
She was able to articulate her ideas clearly in English.
她能用英语清楚地表达自己的想法。
to make sounds like speech without real words, as babies do
Most babies begin to babble at around six months.
大多数婴儿在六个月左右开始咿呀学语。
connected with the voice; expressing opinions openly
Humans have unusual control over their vocal cords.
人类对声带的控制能力非同寻常。
a language that is not your first language
Over a billion people speak English as a second language.
超过十亿人把英语作为第二语言来说。
speaking or using only one language
Monolingual dictionaries explain words in the same language.
单语词典用同一种语言来解释词语。
words on the screen that translate or show what is being said
Watching films with English subtitles can improve listening.
看带英文字幕的电影可以提高听力。
the way a word is written; the ability to write words correctly
A spelling mistake makes an answer wrong in the IELTS listening test.
在雅思听力考试中，拼写错误会让答案判错。
a change in the form of a word to show tense, number and so on
English has fewer inflections than German or Russian.
英语的词形变化比德语和俄语少。
changing between two languages in one conversation
Code-switching is common among bilingual families.
语码转换在双语家庭中很常见。
a language that is not spoken in your own country
Learning a foreign language is compulsory in most European schools.
在大多数欧洲学校，学习一门外语是必修的。
doing or saying the same thing many times
Spaced repetition helps learners remember new words.
间隔重复有助于学习者记住新词。
a natural ability to do something well
Some people seem to have a special aptitude for languages.
有些人似乎特别有语言天赋。
spoken rather than written; connected with words
They had only a verbal agreement, not a written contract.
他们只有口头协议，没有书面合同。
Much of our communication is non-verbal.
我们的交流有很大一部分是非言语的。
the way your movements and position show what you think or feel
Crossed arms are often read as defensive body language.
双臂交叉常被理解为一种防御性的肢体语言。
a movement of the hand or head that expresses something
A thumbs-up gesture is rude in some countries.
竖大拇指的手势在一些国家是不礼貌的。
a look on someone's face that shows their feelings
Some basic facial expressions are understood all over the world.
一些基本的面部表情是全世界都能看懂的。
In some cultures, avoiding eye contact is a sign of respect.
在一些文化中，避免眼神接触是尊重的表现。
the quality of someone's voice that shows their feelings
His tone suggested that he was not happy with the plan.
他的语气表明他对这个计划不满意。
to communicate a feeling, idea or message
Emojis help to convey emotion in short messages.
表情符号有助于在短消息中传达情绪。
a failure to understand something correctly
Cultural differences can easily lead to misunderstandings.
文化差异很容易导致误解。
good at making people agree or believe something
A persuasive essay needs clear reasons and examples.
一篇有说服力的文章需要清晰的理由和例子。
speech or writing that is meant to persuade, sometimes without real meaning
Voters are tired of political rhetoric and want real action.
选民已经厌倦了政治辞令，想要真正的行动。
able to express ideas well and persuasively
She gave an eloquent speech about the value of libraries.
她就图书馆的价值发表了一篇雄辩的演讲。
special words used by a particular group that others find hard to understand
Doctors should explain things to patients without medical jargon.
医生应该不用医学术语向病人解释病情。
very informal words used by a particular group
Teenage slang changes almost every year.
青少年的俚语几乎每年都在变。
suitable for serious or official situations
Academic essays should be written in a formal style.
学术文章应该用正式的文体写。
informal, used in conversation rather than writing
using the basic meaning of a word
A literal translation often sounds unnatural.
逐字翻译往往听起来不自然。
a way of describing something by calling it something else
'Time is money' is a common metaphor in English.
“时间就是金钱”是英语里常见的比喻。
a story or a description of events
Children's narratives become more detailed as they grow older.
孩子长大后，讲的故事会越来越详细。
a small picture used in electronic messages to show a feeling
Some linguists see emojis as a new kind of punctuation.
一些语言学家把表情符号看作一种新的标点。

volumes.name: 医学与疾病
words: an illness caused by bacteria or a virus entering the body
Washing your hands is the simplest way to prevent infection.
洗手是预防感染最简单的方法。
接触传染的；有感染力的
able to spread from one person to another by contact
Measles is one of the most contagious diseases known.
麻疹是已知传染性最强的疾病之一。
a very small living thing that causes disease and multiplies inside cells
Antibiotics do not work against a virus.
抗生素对病毒不起作用。
very small living things, some of which cause disease
Not all bacteria are harmful; many help us digest food.
并非所有细菌都有害，许多细菌帮助我们消化食物。
a bacterium or virus that causes disease
Some pathogens can survive on surfaces for several days.
有些病原体能在物体表面存活好几天。
the parts of the body that fight infection
Lack of sleep can weaken the immune system.
睡眠不足会削弱免疫系统。
the body's ability to resist a disease
People who recover from measles usually have lifelong immunity.
得过麻疹并康复的人通常会终身免疫。
a substance produced by the body to fight disease
The blood test showed antibodies to the virus.
血液检测显示出针对这种病毒的抗体。
a red, painful and swollen area of the body caused by injury or infection
Ice can reduce inflammation after a sports injury.
运动受伤后冰敷可以减轻炎症。
an illness that stops part of the body or mind working normally
Sleep disorders affect as many as one in three adults.
多达三分之一的成年人受睡眠障碍困扰。
a set of symptoms that together show a particular medical condition
Chronic fatigue syndrome can last for years.
慢性疲劳综合征可能持续数年。
a condition that causes a bad reaction to certain foods, plants or substances
Peanut allergies are becoming more common in children.
花生过敏在儿童中越来越常见。
a disease in which the body cannot control the level of sugar in the blood
Type 2 diabetes is closely linked to diet and exercise.
2 型糖尿病与饮食和运动密切相关。
a serious disease in which cells in the body grow in an uncontrolled way
Smoking is the main cause of lung cancer.
吸烟是肺癌的主要原因。
a mass of cells growing in or on the body
Doctors removed the tumour in a three-hour operation.
医生通过一台三小时的手术切除了肿瘤。
connected with the heart and blood vessels
Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death worldwide.
心血管疾病是全球首要死因。
the force with which blood flows around the body
Too much salt can raise blood pressure.
盐吃多了会使血压升高。
a part of the body that has a particular job, such as the heart
The skin is the largest organ of the human body.
皮肤是人体最大的器官。
a unit of DNA that controls a characteristic passed from parents to children
Scientists have identified a gene linked to the disease.
科学家已经找到一个与该疾病有关的基因。
passed from parents to children through genes
Some forms of heart disease are hereditary.
Without treatment, the infection can be fatal.
如果不治疗，这种感染可能致命。
a doctor's opinion about how an illness will develop
If the cancer is found early, the prognosis is good.
如果癌症发现得早，预后就好。
medical care for an illness or injury
New treatments have greatly improved survival rates.
新疗法大大提高了存活率。
treatment to help someone with a physical or mental illness
Talking therapy can be as effective as medication for mild depression.
对于轻度抑郁，谈话疗法可能和药物一样有效。
medical treatment in which a doctor cuts the body; a doctor's office
He needed surgery on his knee after the accident.
事故之后，他的膝盖需要做手术。
The surgeon spent six hours repairing the damaged heart.
外科医生花了六个小时修复受损的心脏。
a drug that stops you feeling pain during an operation
Before anaesthetics, surgery was extremely painful and dangerous.
在麻醉剂出现之前，外科手术极其痛苦和危险。
a doctor's written order for medicine
You need a prescription to buy antibiotics in the UK.
在英国，买抗生素需要处方。
the amount of a medicine taken at one time
Take one dose every eight hours.
Penicillin was the first widely used antibiotic.
青霉素是第一种被广泛使用的抗生素。
She took a painkiller for her headache.
她因为头疼吃了一片止痛药。
a cure for an illness or a solution to a problem
Honey is a traditional remedy for a sore throat.
蜂蜜是治疗喉咙痛的传统方法。
to make an ill person healthy again; a treatment that does this
There is still no cure for the common cold.
普通感冒至今仍无法根治。
to become healthy again, or to make a wound healthy
A broken bone usually takes about six weeks to heal.
骨折通常需要大约六周才能愈合。
an operation in which an organ is moved from one person to another
Thousands of patients are waiting for a kidney transplant.
成千上万的病人在等待肾移植。
a medical test that produces an image of the inside of the body; to look quickly
The brain scan showed no sign of damage.
脑部扫描没有显示任何损伤迹象。
a photograph of the inside of the body
An X-ray confirmed that his wrist was broken.
X 光片证实他的手腕骨折了。
a doctor, especially one who treats illnesses without surgery
Physicians in ancient Greece believed that health depended on balance.
古希腊的医生认为健康取决于平衡。
a person trained to give emergency medical care, usually in an ambulance
Paramedics arrived within eight minutes of the call.
接到电话后八分钟内急救人员就赶到了。
to make pain or a problem less severe
Gentle exercise can alleviate back pain.
温和的运动可以缓解背痛。
a new medical problem that makes an illness worse
The operation went well, with no complications.
手术很顺利，没有出现并发症。
the return of an illness after a period of improvement
Stopping the medicine too early increases the risk of relapse.
过早停药会增加复发的风险。
the ability of bacteria or viruses to survive drugs that used to kill them
Overuse of antibiotics has led to drug resistance.
抗生素的滥用导致了耐药性。
the sudden start of a disease or something dangerous
Health officials are investigating an outbreak of food poisoning.
卫生官员正在调查一起食物中毒事件。
a disease that spreads over a whole country or the whole world
The 1918 flu pandemic killed tens of millions of people.
1918 年的流感大流行造成数千万人死亡。
a period when a person or animal is kept apart to stop a disease spreading
Travellers had to spend two weeks in quarantine.
带菌者；传播者；运输工具
a person or animal that passes on a disease, sometimes without becoming ill
an extra dose of a vaccine that increases protection
In some countries, adults are advised to have a tetanus booster every ten years.
在一些国家，建议成年人每十年打一针破伤风加强针。
a test of a new drug or treatment on patients
The vaccine was tested on 40,000 volunteers in clinical trials.
这种疫苗在临床试验中对四万名志愿者进行了测试。
connected with making and selling medicines
Pharmaceutical companies spend billions on research.
制药公司在研究上投入数十亿。
the study of how diseases spread and can be controlled
Epidemiology helped to show the link between smoking and lung cancer.
流行病学帮助揭示了吸烟和肺癌之间的联系。
the number of deaths in a group of people or a period of time
Infant mortality has fallen sharply over the past century.
过去一个世纪婴儿死亡率大幅下降。
poor health caused by not eating enough or not eating the right food
Malnutrition makes children more likely to catch infections.
营养不良使儿童更容易受到感染。
a lack of something that is needed, especially in the diet
Vitamin D deficiency is common in northern countries in winter.
在北方国家，冬天缺乏维生素 D 很常见。
medical tests to check many people for a disease
Breast cancer screening is offered to women over 50.
五十岁以上的女性可以参加乳腺癌筛查。
有些过敏反应会危及生命。
likely to be harmed or to suffer from something
Older people are most at risk from the flu.
老年人最容易受流感威胁。
easily affected or harmed by something
Young children are more susceptible to infection.
a very small living thing that causes disease
Germs spread easily in crowded classrooms.
病菌在拥挤的教室里很容易传播。
a room or building used for scientific research and tests
The samples were sent to a laboratory for testing.
样本被送到实验室进行检测。
an instrument that makes very small things look larger
Bacteria were first seen under a microscope in the 1670s.
细菌在 17 世纪 70 年代首次在显微镜下被观察到。
a serious illness of the mind that affects memory and thinking
The number of people with dementia is rising as populations age.
随着人口老龄化，痴呆症患者的人数在增加。
a physical or mental condition that limits what a person can do
New buildings must be accessible to people with disabilities.
新建筑必须方便残疾人使用。

volumes.name: 农业与食物
words: the science or practice of farming
Agriculture uses about 70 per cent of the world's fresh water.
农业用水约占全世界淡水使用量的 70%。
Large areas of farmland were lost to new housing.
大片农田被新建住房占用。
a plant grown in large amounts, such as wheat or rice
Rice is the main crop in much of southern China.
水稻是中国南方大部分地区的主要农作物。
the amount of a crop produced; to produce
New varieties of wheat doubled the yield per hectare.
新的小麦品种使每公顷产量翻了一番。
animals kept on a farm, such as cows, sheep and pigs
Livestock farming produces a large share of greenhouse gases.
畜牧业产生了很大一部分温室气体。
cows and bulls kept on a farm
Cattle need large areas of land for grazing.
chickens, ducks and other birds kept for eggs or meat
Poultry is the most widely eaten meat in many countries.
在许多国家，禽肉是食用最广泛的肉类。
connected with milk or made from milk
Cheese, butter and yoghurt are dairy products.
奶酪、黄油和酸奶都是乳制品。
to eat grass in a field
Sheep graze on the hills during the summer.
to turn over the soil before planting seeds
Farmers once used horses to plough their fields.
to put seeds in the ground so that they grow
Wheat is usually sown in the autumn.
a chemical used to kill insects that damage crops
Some pesticides harm bees as well as pests.
有些杀虫剂在杀死害虫的同时也会伤害蜜蜂。
animal waste used to make soil richer
Organic farmers use manure instead of chemical fertilisers.
有机农民用粪肥代替化肥。
grown or produced without artificial chemicals
Organic vegetables usually cost more than ordinary ones.
有机蔬菜通常比普通蔬菜贵。
farming that uses machines and chemicals to get as much as possible from the land
Intensive farming produces cheap food but can damage the soil.
集约农业能生产廉价食物，但可能破坏土壤。
kept in natural conditions and allowed to move around outside
Free-range eggs come from hens that can go outdoors.
散养鸡蛋来自能到户外活动的母鸡。
a glass building in which plants are grown
Tomatoes can be grown all year round in heated greenhouses.
在加温的温室里，西红柿一年四季都能种。
a piece of land where fruit trees are grown
The village is surrounded by apple orchards.
这个村庄被苹果园环绕着。
growing different crops in a field each year to keep the soil healthy
Crop rotation reduces the need for chemical fertilisers.
轮作减少了对化肥的需求。
having genes that have been changed by scientists
Genetically modified crops can resist certain pests.
转基因作物能抵抗某些害虫。
a farmer who works a small area of land
Much of the world's coffee is grown by smallholders.
世界上很大一部分咖啡是由小农种植的。
a large farm building for storing crops or keeping animals
The hay was stored in the barn for the winter.
干草储存在谷仓里过冬。
supplying water to land so that crops can grow
